package.name: tactical_ugv_autonomous_stack
package.description: ROS2 replacement for comm_server. Provides one bridge node per legacy planner binary (goal_generation, path_planner, trajectory_planner) that exposes the map/pose/goal/path/ constraints/trajectory data those binaries already produce and consume as ROS2 topics, without modifying any of the legacy planner source code. Each node's source lives under src/<package>/src/ alongside that package's own (untouched) legacy sources.
